verses.text: From Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the command of God our Saviour and of the Lord Jesus Christ, who is our hope.
To Timothy, my true son in the faith. Grace, mercy and peace to you from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
When I was leaving for Macedonia, I urged you to stay in Ephesus. Stay there so that you can order certain people to stop teaching wrong ideas.
Tell them not to give their attention to myths and to endless lists of ancestors. These things cause arguments. They do not help God's plan, which works through faith.
The goal of this order is love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience and a faith that is real.
Some people have missed this goal. They have turned away to talk that is empty.
They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying, or the things they are so sure about.
We know that the law is good if people use it in the right way.

We also know that the law is not made for people who do right. It is for people who break the law and refuse to obey, for those who do not respect God and for sinners, for those who are unholy and do not care about God. It is for people who kill their fathers or mothers, and for murderers,

for people who commit sexual sin, for men who have sex with men, for people who buy and sell slaves, for liars, for those who lie under oath, and for anything else that goes against true and healthy teaching.
This teaching agrees with the glorious Good News of the blessed God, which he trusted me with.
I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength. I thank him because he thought I could be trusted, and he chose me to serve him.
Once I spoke against God, attacked his people, and was cruel and proud. But God showed me mercy, because I did not know what I was doing. I did not believe.
The grace of our Lord was poured out on me in great measure, together with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
Here is a saying you can trust, which everyone should accept: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and I am the worst of them.

But that is why God showed me mercy. Christ Jesus wanted to use me, the worst sinner, to show how very patient he is. I am an example for those who would later believe in him and receive life that lasts for ever.
Now to the King who rules for ever, who never dies and cannot be seen, the only God who is wise, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
My son Timothy, I give you this instruction. It agrees with the prophecies that were spoken about you before. By following them you can fight the good fight,
holding on to faith and a clear conscience. Some people have pushed their conscience away, and so their faith has been wrecked like a ship.
Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have handed them over to Satan, so that they will learn not to speak against God.
